technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with short-term bullish technicals (Hull flip, MACD crossover) offset by price below key moving averages and weak volume confirmation; moderate risk/reward for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: VMC shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 51 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; market fear (44 VIX-equivalent) presents potential contrarian opportunity, but stale trades (300+ days old) and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (461), flat yield curve recession signal, rising USD headwind for Materials sector, FOMC event in 2 days, and earnings in 51 days create compounded risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip + MACD crossover up with price near support (168.58) offer short-term momentum entry in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis (VIX 461, FOMC in 2 days, flat yield curve), price below all key moving averages, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 51 days create compounded headwinds that overwhelm weak technical signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and MACD crossover provide short-term momentum at support, but macro crisis (VIX 461, FOMC in 2 days) and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC event in 2 days combined with VIX in crisis territory and flat yield curve recession signal could trigger sharp reversal, invalidating technical setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already 4 positions in Materials sector; adding VMC increases concentration risk during macro stress without fundamental or institutional support.
